production.direction_en: Glass vials roll down a muddy slope. Kera is defending her overturned cart with a brass hand mortar and a look of personal offense.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_comic — pizzicato, rolling glass | post: bgm_ch1_ash_forest

commands.speaker: kera_voss
commands.text: Those bottles were sorted by volatility. You have turned them into a choir.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: We can help you gather them after the dead are gone.

commands.speaker: kera_voss
commands.text: Good. Try not to step on the red ones. Or the blue ones. Or anything that smells like almonds.
